faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIITDM Jabalpur JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IIITDM Jabalpur is September 1, 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Graduate or Post Graduate Degree (BE/BTech/ME/MTech) in Computer Science and Engineering, AI and Data Science, Information Technology, or similar branches.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The age limit is preferably below 35 years as on the date of the written test and/or interview for the JRF position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000 + 20% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIITDM Jabalpur JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online by filling out the Google Form provided on the official website or through the direct application link.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a written test/skill test followed by an interview. However, the written test may be relaxed for GATE/NET qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IIITDM Jabalpur.

faq.question: Q9. What is the type of job for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a project-based job opportunity at IIITDM Jabalpur.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIITDM Jabalpur located?
faq.answer: IIITDM Jabalpur is located in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, with the pincode 482005.
